title: С + genitive: Since morning, from Monday

blocks.text: «С + Gen. meaning „from“ or „since“: Он живёт здесь с прошлого года. Сегодня с утра идёт дождь.» «„С + Gen. … до + Gen.“ — „from … to“: Я был занят с утра до вечера.»

DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 75. One sentence at a time, in a new order each time you open this chapter; it is finished when every one has been answered right. The sentences are real: the source of each is shown with it.
